model_necessity_claims: advisory verdict from an isolated cross-family reviewer subprocess whose report is schema-checked, run_id-matched and verdict-vetted by deterministic parser code; the engine itself never lets the reviewer output bypass the parse gate

agent_reasoning.alternative_rejected_because: a deterministic self-check cannot refute its own reasoning family; the acceptance contract requires an independent model-family verdict, so reviewer prose is necessary and only its schema-checked VerdictReport projection is trusted
agent_reasoning.deterministic_alternative: bind the process's own deterministic checks as the verdict and skip external review
agent_reasoning.unstructured_input: free-form cross-family reviewer prose verdict about the run artifact set

model_countermeasures: the reviewer subprocess is classified MODEL with no deterministic credit
reviewer output is only consumed via parse_verdict, which rejects malformed payloads and mismatched run_id values
a missing or invalid reviewer verdict yields a deterministic NO_VERDICT failure record and no seal is emitted

steps.mechanism: subprocess launch of the canonical rig-loop CLI provisioning the run state under the loop-state root
deterministic gate-table lookup over IQRSQPI stage artifacts
subprocess launch of the canonical rig-loop slice executor
subprocess launch of an isolated cross-family reviewer; output consumed only through the deterministic parser
schema check, run_id match, and verdict-vocabulary vetting of the reviewer report (D85_VERDICT_MALFORMED on violation)
deterministic fallback to the local verdict file when the reviewer report is malformed
deterministic NO_VERDICT failure record when no valid verdict exists
content-hash binding of run artifacts and verdict into the evidence packet
ProofPacket seal executed by the canonical loop CLI with proof hash
receipt serialization to stdout for the calling harness

outward_effect.channel: local filesystem via subprocess launch of the canonical rig-loop binary
outward_effect.effect_detail: run state writes under the loop-state root and ProofPacket seals, executed only by the canonical loop CLI under Gate-D discipline
